$comment: Every domain state → label, Badge variant and icon. Labels are Turkish UI copy (drafts where marked). No default depends on an open decision: 'target' is the tone a row takes once 'inherits' is decided. Keys are descriptive where the API has no enum yet. Rules: MDS-STAT-01, MDS-COL-03, MDS-COL-08; open decisions are listed at the end of rules.md.

fields.state: the API enum value, or a descriptive key where the API has none
fields.label: the badge text; null = no badge
fields.badge: the Badge variant (.mds-badge--<variant>); brand and live are contracted, not built yet (rules.md, Contracted, not built yet)
fields.icon: the glyph beside the label, by its icon registry name
fields.dot: true: the 8px dot in currentColor goes before the label
fields.cta: the primary action shown in this state; an object when it depends on the course (approval required or direct)
fields.text: a sentence shown in place of a badge
fields.shows: what else this state puts beside the badge
fields.audience: who sees the row: 'management' = only those whose role lets them manage the thing in Nizam; absent = everyone who can see the thing
fields.target: the tone the row takes once 'inherits' is decided
fields.inherits: the open decision the target waits on
fields.provisional: the type is not authorable yet; the row exists so it can be rendered
fields.note: why the row differs from a source
fields.render: the class that draws it, when it is not a Badge; .mds-nav-item__count is contracted, not built yet (rules.md)
fields.srSuffix: text after the value for screen readers only

enrolment.talebe.note: also the state after a rejected application: the API deletes the pending enrolment, so the talebe may apply again

enrolment.talebe.label: Önizleme
enrolment.talebe.text: Kurs henüz yayında değil; bu önizlemeyi yalnızca yöneticiler görür.

session.label: Sona erdi
session.note: the brief's C7 says 'tamamlandı'; relabelled so one label has one variant ('Tamamlandı' is success elsewhere), and Tedris already says 'Sona erdi' — the owner's copy decides

ezber.$comment: Post-launch: no A–C launch screen shows ezber. States are the PRD enum (M5-2), which the API also uses: NEW, LEARNING, MASTERED.
